extracted.intended_audience: potential authors and reviewers of Biochemia Medica (researchers submitting biomedical manuscripts)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for authors submitting manuscripts to Biochemia Medica, covering revised Instructions to authors, a new Research Integrity Corner, required Author statement form, and mandatory ICMJE conflict-of-interest disclosure during online submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research Integrity Corner
rubrics_metrics.description: Launch of a special journal section called Research Integrity Corner.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: In this section we aim to publish educational articles dealing with different research and publication misconduct issues; intended to raise awareness of authors and reviewers for research and publication integrity issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: Revised Instructions to authors (comprehensive)
rubrics_metrics.description: Comprehensive revision of Instructions to authors that additionally describes the editorial procedure for all submitted articles and provides exact journal policies towards research integrity, authorship, copyright and conflict of interest.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Whereas our former Instructions to authors have mostly been concerned with recommendations for manuscript preparation and submission, the revised document additionally describes the editorial procedure and exact journal policies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Manuscript preparation and submission recommendations
rubrics_metrics.description: Recommendations for manuscript preparation and submission (former focus of the Instructions to authors).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These remain part of the Instructions to authors and cover how manuscripts should be prepared and submitted to the journal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Editorial procedure transparency
rubrics_metrics.description: Description of the editorial procedure for all submitted articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The revised Instructions specify the editorial workflow so authors understand how submissions are handled (peer review/editor decisions/process).

rubrics_metrics.name: Journal policies on research integrity
rubrics_metrics.description: Exact journal policies towards research integrity are provided in the revised guidelines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Policies are now visible and available to potential authors to raise awareness and prevent research and publication misconduct.

rubrics_metrics.name: Authorship statements (Author statement form)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Author statement form now contains statements on the authorship.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors must complete the form to declare authorship (contributions, responsibility and related authorship assertions) as part of submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Originality of work declaration
rubrics_metrics.description: Author statement form includes statements on the originality of work.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors must affirm that the submitted work is original (implicit expectation to avoid plagiarism and duplicate publication).

rubrics_metrics.name: Research ethics declaration
rubrics_metrics.description: Author statement form contains statements on research ethics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors are required to declare compliance with research ethics (e.g., ethical approvals, humane treatment, appropriate conduct) as part of the submission process.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patient privacy and confidentiality
rubrics_metrics.description: Author statement form contains statements on patient privacy and confidentiality.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors must attest to protecting patient privacy and confidentiality (e.g., anonymization, consent) when applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Copyright transfer
rubrics_metrics.description: Author statement form contains statements on copyright transfer.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The form includes a declaration/transfer of copyright to the journal as required for publication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adoption of ICMJE Conflict-of-Interest Form
rubrics_metrics.description: Journal has adopted the ICMJE Form for Disclosure of Potential Conflicts of Interest.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: From this issue, for each submitted article, authors are requested to fill out the 'ICMJE Form for Disclosure of Potential Conflicts of Interest' and upload it during the online manuscript submission process.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mandatory upload of Author statement and ICMJE forms
rubrics_metrics.description: Authors are required to upload both the Author statement form and the ICMJE Conflict-of-Interest form during online manuscript submission.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These forms must be submitted for each article as part of the journal's submission requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Visibility and accessibility of ethical policies
rubrics_metrics.description: Putting the Guidelines into action to make ethical policies and requirements visible and available to potential authors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The journal expects that clearer, accessible policies will raise awareness and guide author behaviour.

rubrics_metrics.name: Expectation to improve submission and publication quality
rubrics_metrics.description: The implemented editorial policy changes aim to improve the quality of submissions and published articles by raising awareness of integrity issues.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: By enforcing declarations and clearer procedures, the journal intends to enhance overall manuscript quality and ethical compliance.
